question: Prithviraj Raso, an epic poem about the life of the 12th century Indian king, Prithviraj Chauhan, was written by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chand Bardai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prithviraj Raso:-**

 
 
• **It is an epic poem in the Braj language about the life of Prithviraj Chauhan, a 12th-century Rajput king of Ajmer and Delhi. **
 
• **The poem is attributed to Chand Bardai, who was Prithviraj's court poet.**
 
• The poem begins with the birth of Prithviraj and his childhood. It then recounts his early military campaigns, his marriage to Sanyogita, and his defeat by Muhammad of Ghor in the Battle of Tarain in 1192.
 
• The poem is a mix of history, legend, and romance. It is full of vivid descriptions of battles, courtly love, and religious devotion. It is also a powerful expression of Rajput pride and martial prowess.
 
• Prithviraj Raso is one of the most important works of Hindi literature. It has been translated into many languages, including English, and it has been adapted for the stage and screen.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Banabhatta:-**

 
 
• **He was a Sanskrit poet who lived in the 7th century CE. **
 
• He was the court poet of King Harshavardhana of the Vardhana dynasty.
 
• Banabhatta is best known for his two major works, the Harshacharita and the Kadambari.
 
 
 
• **Ashvaghosa:-**
 
 
• **He was a Buddhist monk and poet who lived in the 1st century CE. **
 
• He is best known for his two major works, the Buddhacarita and the Saundarananda.
 
 
 
• **Bharavi:-**
 
 
• **He was a Sanskrit poet who lived in the 6th century CE. He is best known for his epic poem, the Kiratarjuniya**.
